title: Curated quant intake orchestrator and regression tally
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a robust intake and verification pipeline for quantized model artifacts (INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ) that enforces a manifest schema, runs automated performance and quality validations, calculates a compact regression tally, and integrates with the version-pinning/promotion flow. Deliverables: artifact schema v2, continuous regression tally report, auto-blocking criteria, and promotion API hooks for pinning variants to the model catalog.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact manifest schema v2 published and validated against existing storage (fields: format, bitwidth, calibration-data-id, quant-config-hash, baseline-model-id, macs, peak-memory, ops-profile)
Automated validation harness executes unit + workload smoke suites for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ artifacts within CI and reports a single regression tally score per artifact
Regression tally thresholds defined per workload type (conversational, embedding, classification) and enforced by CI; artifacts failing thresholds are auto-marked 'hold' and cannot be promoted
Promotion API endpoint implements pinning flow: stage -> limited-traffic -> full; requires at least one human approval if regression tally delta > configured non-zero soft threshold
Dashboards show artifact-level trendlines (PPL, embedding-cosine, accuracy, median latency, p99 latency, throughput) and expose change reasons (quant format, sequence length, batch size)
Alerting rules configured: quality regression, latency regression, throughput degradation; each rule maps to a remediation runbook and an auto-rollback policy
steps: Design manifest schema v2 and backward compatibility layer
Implement artifact ingestion service with signature verification and metadata extraction
Extend CI smoke harness with quant-aware workloads and generate standardized metrics output (JSONL)
Compute a regression tally: weighted aggregation of quality and perf deltas vs pinned baseline
Integrate tally into the model registry: store artifact metadata, tally, and promotion state
Expose promotion API and UI hooks in Console for staged rollouts and pin management
Create dashboards and alerts; add runbooks for common failure modes
Document developer guidelines and onboarding checklist for partners and internal model ops
comments: 2025-02-14 Maya Patel: Initial ticket created. Goal: unify quant artifact onboarding and make promotion safe. Listed formats: INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ. Put Aaron as owner for implementation.

2025-02-17 Aaron Cho: Spike finished. Found two conflicting fields in downstream registry (calibration-id vs calib_snapshot). Decided to adopt 'calibration-data-id' as canonical and provide a tiny compatibility shim in ingestion service.

2025-02-21 Lena Martinez (QA): Added list of recommended smoke workloads for conversational vs embeddings vs classification. Will attach harness config. Emphasis on sampling long-context sequences for FP8 instability detection.

2025-02-25 Diego Alvarez (Runtime): Preliminary perf tests show AWQ variants reduce memory by ~25% but increase p99 latency by 8% for batch=1 on older kernels. Need kernel-selection hint in manifest to prefer newer cudnn/mkl when available.
2025-02-28 Aaron Cho: Implemented manifest parser and signature verification. Pushed branch quant-intake:feature/manifest-v2. CI step emits metrics JSON and uploads to artifact store.

2025-03-01 Sarah Kim (PM): Reviewed acceptance criteria; requested explicit delta thresholds per workload. Added request: embeddings cosine delta <= 0.002 relative, PPL delta <= 1.5% relative for conversational, accuracy drop <= 0.5% absolute for classification.

2025-03-03 Aaron Cho: Regression tally prototype computes weight(quality)=0.7, weight(perf)=0.3 and normalizes across metrics. Exported daily artifact leaderboard. Observed one GPTQ artifact flagged for embedding cosine -0.004; auto-hold triggered as expected.

2025-03-04 Priya Nair (Design): Console mockups ready for promotion UI. Two new states: 'hold' and 'quarantine' for artifacts. 'Hold' requires author action; 'quarantine' reserved for security-related failures.

2025-03-04 Maya Patel: Decision log: Promotion flow will require human approval only when regression_tally > 0.005 (soft threshold) or customer-impact label present. Otherwise allow automated staged rollout to reduce ops friction.
tradeoffs: Strict gating improves safety but increases time-to-production for experimental variants; decided on hybrid approach with soft thresholds and human approval for larger deltas
Computing comprehensive metrics (end-to-end evals) is costly; we rely on representative smoke workloads plus periodic full-eval runs to balance cost and coverage
Embedding cosine is sensitive to seed differences; we normalize using multiple runs and use median to reduce false positives
runbook_snippet:
Alert: embedding_cosine_drop > configured_threshold
  Triage: look at calibration-data-id and sequence-length distribution in recent traffic
  Quick mitigation: pin previous artifact version and initiate fast rollback; open Incident ticket; run expanded eval with larger sample

Alert: p99 latency regressed > 25%
  Triage: check kernel selection hint and hardware affinity; if AWQ/GPTQ on older kernels, mark artifact for 'degraded-hardware' and recommend kernel pinning or rollback
notes: We will publish 'quant-intake-spec-v2' to Confluence and add a migration script for legacy artifacts. Expect ~2 weeks of partner onboarding for external model providers.
Telemetry: ensure tallies are emitted with artifact_id and baseline_id tags to enable historical diffing; avoid PII in metrics payloads.
